properties.query:
// Guardar como función MDCAI_V3_Base; parámetro Lookback:timespan.
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(Lookback)
| where ProductName in~ ("Azure Security Center", "Microsoft Defender for Cloud")
| where AlertType startswith_cs "AI.Azure_" or AlertType startswith_cs "AI.AIModelScan_"
| where isnotempty(SystemAlertId)
| project TimeGenerated, StartTime, ProcessingEndTime, TenantId, SystemAlertId, VendorOriginalId, AlertType, AlertName,
          AlertSeverity, AlertStatus=Status, AlertLink, ResourceId, LiveAttackTactics=Tactics, LiveAttackTechniques=Techniques
| extend AlertKey = strcat(TenantId, "/", SystemAlertId),
         ActivityTime = iff(isnotnull(StartTime) and StartTime > datetime(2000-01-01) and StartTime <= TimeGenerated, StartTime, TimeGenerated)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlertKey

// Guardar como función MDCAI_V3_Enriched; parámetro Lookback:timespan.
let profiles = _GetWatchlist('MDCAI_V3_Profiles')
    | where MappingVersion == "3.0.0"
    | project AlertType=tostring(SearchKey), MappingVersion, OfficialName, DocumentedSeverity, DocumentedAttack,
              ReleaseStatus, SignalScope, Signal, Disposition, AutoCAAT, AutoATLAS, AutoOWASP2025, AutoOWASP2026,
              Meaning, Triage, EvidenceBoundary, LearnUrl;
MDCAI_V3_Base(Lookback)
| lookup kind=leftouter profiles on AlertType
| extend Disposition = iff(isempty(MappingVersion), "unclassified", Disposition),
         MappingVersion = iff(isempty(MappingVersion), "3.0.0", MappingVersion),
         DirectCAAT = iff(isempty(AutoCAAT), dynamic([]), split(AutoCAAT, ";")),
         DirectATLAS = iff(isempty(AutoATLAS), dynamic([]), split(AutoATLAS, ";")),
         DirectOWASP2025 = iff(isempty(AutoOWASP2025), dynamic([]), split(AutoOWASP2025, ";")),
         DirectOWASP2026 = iff(isempty(AutoOWASP2026), dynamic([]), split(AutoOWASP2026, ";")),
         SignalScope = iff(isempty(SignalScope), "unclassified", SignalScope)
| project-away AutoCAAT, AutoATLAS, AutoOWASP2025, AutoOWASP2026

// Guardar como función MDCAI_V3_Escenarios; parámetro Lookback:timespan.
let obs = MDCAI_V3_Enriched(Lookback)
    | mv-expand CAAT_Id=DirectCAAT to typeof(string)
    | summarize Ultima=max(TimeGenerated) by CAAT_Id, AlertKey
    | summarize AlertasDirectas=count(), Ultima=max(Ultima) by CAAT_Id;
_GetWatchlist('MDCAI_V3_CAAT')
| where MappingVersion == "3.0.0"
| project CAAT_Id=tostring(SearchKey), Scenario, Family_Proposed, DocumentedLink, LearnUrl
| lookup kind=leftouter obs on CAAT_Id
| extend AlertasDirectas=coalesce(AlertasDirectas, tolong(0))
| extend Lectura=iff(AlertasDirectas > 0, "Actividad con vínculo directo propuesto", "Sin actividad con vínculo directo en el período")
| order by CAAT_Id asc
